meta.title: Goblin Mode: Snack Run
meta.instructions: Drag Grub around the 2 AM kitchen. Grab pizza, dodge alarm clocks and angry emails. Five snacks in a row unlocks GOBLIN MODE: for five seconds you eat your responsibilities. Lose all 3 brain cells and it's bedtime. Clear 5 waves to win.

colliders.body: if now < gm_until or in_break then [] else concat(map(spawns, s => vec(s.x, s.y)), map(emails, e => vec(e.x, e.y)))

rules.when: goblin_on() and (any(spawns, s => near(s.x, s.y)) or any(emails, e => near(e.x, e.y)))

let.n: count(spawns, s => near(s.x, s.y)) + count(emails, e => near(e.x, e.y))

template.fill: = if goblin_on() then $primary else if k < streak then $accent else '#FFFFFF33'

node.text: = if goblin_on() then 'GOBLIN MODE' else if in_break then 'breather...' else 'snack streak'

children.text: = if status == 'won' then 'SNACK LEGEND' else 'BRAIN CELLS: 0'
= str(collected) + ' snacks  |  made it to wave ' + str(max(1, wave))
= if status == 'won' then 'The fridge light is your spotlight now. Go to bed. (You will not.)' else 'Responsibilities: 1. Goblin: 0. Rematch at 2:48 AM?'

art.style: 2 AM kitchen raid: violet wallpaper, a glowing open fridge, a green goblin in a purple hoodie, flying alarm clocks and angry emails, pizza slices.
